title: ‘Task’ Star Tom Pelphrey on Finding Himself in His Devoted Dad Role — and Nearly Playing Professor X
summary: The two-time Emmy nominee was a runner-up for the new 'X-Men' movie, and jokes that at least audiences won't have to see him bald: "The only hat I can wear is a fitted size eight. It is empirically a big fat head, and I don't know if we want to see it shaved."
